title: Kestrel Care Vehicle Service Contract Underwriting Rule: One Plan per VIN
content:
**Rule.** A plan may be sold on a VIN only when no other plan on that VIN is pending activation or active. Plans held on different vehicles never combine their limits or benefits.

On the Kestrel Care Vehicle Service Contract the vehicle is identified by its 17-character VIN, as written on the plan. Whether a further plan may be sold on a vehicle is decided from the company's plan records for that same VIN — the status of every other plan recorded on it — and not from what the customer says about the vehicle's coverage.

## Status of the other plans on the same VIN

| Status of another plan on the same VIN | Effect under this rule on a sale on that VIN |
|---|---|
| Pending activation | No plan may be sold on the VIN |
| Active | No plan may be sold on the VIN |
| Cancelled | No bar under this rule |
| Expired | No bar under this rule |
| Limit exhausted | No bar under this rule |

Under this rule a sale on the VIN is possible only when none of the other plans on it is pending activation or active; one other plan in either of those statuses is enough to close it. A plan on a different VIN is never an "other plan on that VIN", whoever holds it.

## Plans on different vehicles stay separate

Each plan's aggregate limit of liability and each of its benefits belong to that plan's own vehicle. Plans on different vehicles never combine their limits or benefits, even when one customer holds them all.

### Hypothetical cases

1. A VIN carries one earlier plan whose status is expired. No other plan on the VIN is pending activation or active, so this rule places no bar on a sale on the VIN.
2. A VIN carries one plan that is cancelled and one that is pending activation. The pending plan closes the VIN to a further sale.
3. A customer holds a hypothetical plan with 2000.00 of limit remaining on one vehicle and another with 9000.00 remaining on a second vehicle. A claim on the first vehicle draws only on the first plan's limit; the second plan's limit is never added to it.
